description: Sudan: Road/River Intersections is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Planetary Response Network. This is a line dataset of the locations where a wadi (dried river bed) intersects a key access road in Sudan. The line gives the length of which the road is impacted by the wadi. Coverage: Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher Planetary Response Network. Its tags are flooding, logistics, roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
